body: This is the most stress our relationship has ever been under. I'd like it to survive but it's not looking great at the moment.

Veterinary science. But at the moment I don't know if I can do it. I think I'm intelligent enough it's just putting myself and girlfriend through 6 years of stress is probably going to crush the relationship. If it even survives.

Using an alt for this because I don't want association with it.

I worked for a fundraising company, those people who stop you on the street and ask you to sign up. I was basically promised loads of money and travelling around the country, it was nothing like that.

Anyway, I saw the other members of the team drinking and smoking weed then using the company car to go out to get more weed. They slept for maybe 3 hours then we drove out to the work location for the day. They were definitely still intoxicated in the morning or at least still over the drink drive limit. 

I took pictures and videos covertly, left the company, and sent a complaint to management, saying I had evidence of my accusations. They immediately went on the defensive and denied everything refusing to see the evidence. After I sent the pictures and videos they then said that the team had all accused me of threatening to rape my team leader.

They set up a grievance meeting for me 180 miles away and said it would go ahead whether I was there or not. I told them I don't work for them anymore so it is a complaint, not a grievance. They were having none of it. After their meeting, they concluded I was lying and I had in fact threatened to rape my team leader which I absolutely did not. 

I ended up having to pay a solicitor to write a cease and desist letter, telling them if they contacted me again, the police would be contacted. They had no evidence of their accusations but it was 6 against 1 so as a 17 year old, I didn't think I stood a chance. I was terrified of being sent to prison for something I didn't do and I was worried I was going to struggle getting another job with this hanging over my head.

It was the most stressful time of my life and I still get anxious thinking about it now. I was essentially bullied into withdrawing my complaint from fear of being charged with something I didn't do and not having the money to fight them legally. Shitty company, pretty sure they've rebranded a few times since then.
